seriesTitle: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead

episodes.title: Akira of the Dead
episodes.summary: Akira finds himself being chased by hordes of undead when a zombie pandemic breaks out.

episodes.title: Bucket List of the Dead
episodes.summary: Seeking to reclaim 3 years worth of unused vacation time, Akira spends his days being lazy, day drinking and ignoring the chaos happening in the word; unfortunately he's down to his last beer.

episodes.title: Best Friend of the Dead
episodes.summary: Akira makes his way to Shinjuku to see Kencho, the only friend he's still in touch with.

episodes.title: Flight Attendant of the Dead
episodes.summary: Akira and Kencho  flee into the basement of a department store and meet a trio of flight attendants, checking one more item off the bucket list.

episodes.title: Hero of the Dead
episodes.summary: Remembering his childhood dream, Akira goes into the aquarium to grab a certain item, only to run into a group of survivors running for their lives.

episodes.title: RV of the Dead
episodes.summary: Akira bids farewell to Tokyo and starts the journey back to his hometown, Gunma; but first, he stops by a showroom in Saitama to get an RV.

episodes.title: Truck Stop of the Dead
episodes.summary: Akira finds himself sucked back in to his old, corporate drone mindset. Seeing him in that state  triggers bad memories for Shizuka

episodes.title: Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead
episodes.summary: With only a little farther to go until they reach Akira's hometown in Gunma, the gang runs into a German college student named Beatrix. Despite the zombie pandemic, she says that she is determined to make her dream come true while she's in Japan.

episodes.title: Treehouse of the Dead
episodes.summary: With the only tunnel to the village sealed off, Akira and the others decide to cut through the forest and cross the mountain; along the way, they run into a man named Kumano, who is constructing a treehouse in the forest.

episodes.title: Hometown Of The Dead I
episodes.summary: Together with the villagers and the people who escaped from Tokyo, Akira and his friends help each other out while enjoying a brief moment of happiness; Meanwhile, Higurashi has been preparing to take his revenge on society.

episodes.title: Hometown of the Dead II
episodes.summary: Akira and his friends split up to save the villagers from the massive swarm of zombies; but zombies aren't their only concern as Higurashi and his gang stand in their way; Teruo manages to stop the zombies by himself, but he is captured by Higurashi.

episodes.title: Hometown of the Dead III
episodes.summary: Akira's time may have finally run out, but his bucket list was still half full.
